sourceRecords.title: Floating Wind Test Site Offshore Spain Gets Regulatory Nod
sourceRecords.sourceText: OffshoreWIND.biz reported that the PlemCat test site for floating offshore wind projects in the Spanish Mediterranean received favourable Environmental Impact Assessment approval. The source states that the milestone clears the path for the NextFloat project using X1 Wind X100 8.5 MW platform.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.

sourceRecords.title: Keeping floating wind at the forefront
sourceRecords.sourceText: Tethys listed a TAILWIND factsheet on sustainable station-keeping systems for floating offshore wind, covering anchor concepts, fibre rope mooring lines, shared-anchor opportunities, recycling pathways, and bottlenecks.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.

sourceRecords.title: HEC-WSI: From GPU-Accelerated OpenFOAM to High-Fidelity Modelling of Offshore Floating Wind Turbines
sourceRecords.sourceText: ARCHER2 announced a webinar on OpenFOAM modelling of offshore floating wind turbines, including breaking-wave interaction, scale simulation, mooring coupling, and high-performance computing workflows.

sourceRecords.title: Addressing the UK's clean energy goals: How multiscale computer modelling can benefit wind farms
sourceRecords.sourceText: CoSeC reported that code-coupling tools are being applied to floating offshore wind turbine systems where coupled fluid-structure dynamics are important for performance, safety, and resilience.

sourceRecords.title: Saitec Tests Nature Inclusive Design Installations at Floating Wind Platform
sourceRecords.sourceText: Marine Technology News reported that Saitec Offshore Technologies is using DemoSATH Lab to test nature-inclusive design installations and aquaculture co-location methods on an operating floating wind demonstrator.
